claims.promise: The homeowner captures a reference-object-assisted room trace with level and tilt guidance, then corrects every wall and opening directly on the redrawing plan instead of trusting an opaque automatic scan.

comparison.limitation: A sampled 2-star review says its scanned dimensions were not accurate.

evidence.finding: The floor-plan-scanner sample had 25/29 hand-on-job cards and a CubiCasa 2-star review says, 'Pretty cool, unless you are wanting accurate dimensions.'

claims.deferredReason: No capture path exists; resolve only when fixture tests compare reference-assisted and manually corrected wall values to taped dimensions and prove the sketch redraws.

claims.promise: The homeowner receives wall, floor, and ceiling quantities with doors and windows subtracted, then paint, tile, drywall, flooring, and adhesive pack counts rounded with editable waste and local prices.

comparison.limitation: The measured listing is a floor-plan tool with ads and IAP; this recon did not measure an opening-subtracted multi-material purchase plan in its listing.

evidence.finding: The measured candidate shelves split room planning, measurement, and estimating; the proposed quantity workflow follows the homeowner's purchase job and needs direct product comparison before claiming exclusivity.

claims.deferredReason: No geometry or catalogue engine exists; resolve only when deterministic fixtures prove openings subtract from the correct surfaces, waste is applied once, and pack rounding matches known cases.

claims.promise: The homeowner exports a locally generated PDF containing room dimensions, opening deductions, material quantities, prices, assumptions, and optional photos to a contractor or shop without an account or subscription.

comparison.limitation: A sampled 1-star review calls its export unusable even for full-subscription customers.

evidence.finding: The floor-plan sample has 7 paywall complaints among 14 critical reviews and a Draw Floor Plan review says, 'Unusable export feature for full-subscription customers.'

claims.deferredReason: No PDF/export flow exists; resolve only when a test verifies PdfDocument output via ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT and a FileProvider ACTION_SEND handoff.

claims.promise: The room plan, bundled catalogue, calculations, and PDF work locally without a sign-in or cellular connection after installation.

comparison.limitation: A sampled 2-star review says the app cannot be used without cellular signal because it requires login.

evidence.finding: A HOVER 2-star review states, 'Without a cellular signal, you can't use the app because it requires you to log in.'

claims.deferredReason: No implementation exists; resolve only when an offline device test completes an existing room plan and writes a PDF with networking disabled.
